{{Quote|Visiting dignitaries are swarming to the Moncaladrome. The opening opera should last five hours.|Leia Organa, to [[Tunga Arpagion]]|<ref name="Star Wars 46" />}}
The '''Moncaladrome''' was an [[opera]] house on the [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]]. A [[Heroes of Yavin|team]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] led by [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] traveled to the Moncaladrome in order to capture [[Moff]] [[Tan Hubi]] and use his biosignature to help access the [[prison]] where [[King of Mon Cala|King]] [[Lee-Char]] was being [[Prisoner|held]] by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Star Wars 46" />
